TENANT WORK LETTER

This Tenant Work Letter (this "Work Letter") is attached to and made a part of the Office Lease dated April 14, 2026 between Brightwater Tower Owner LLC ("Landlord") and Kestrel Analytics, Inc. ("Tenant") for Suite 1900 at 300 Brightwater Plaza, Denver, Colorado (the "Premises"). Capitalized terms used but not defined in this Work Letter have the meanings given in the Lease.

1. TENANT IMPROVEMENTS

1.1 Scope. Landlord shall construct the improvements to the Premises shown on the approved Construction Documents (the "Tenant Improvements"), using building-standard materials except where the approved Construction Documents specify otherwise.

1.2 Space Plan and Construction Documents. Tenant shall deliver its space plan by May 15, 2026 and Landlord shall respond within ten (10) business days. Tenant shall deliver Construction Documents by June 30, 2026. Landlord shall approve or reject the Construction Documents within ten (10) business days, and any rejection shall state the reasons with specificity. A submission Landlord does not reject within that period is deemed approved.

2. TENANT IMPROVEMENT ALLOWANCE

2.1 Allowance. Landlord shall provide a tenant improvement allowance of $75.00 per rentable square foot of the Premises, or $1,462,500 in the aggregate (the "Allowance"), to be applied to the hard and soft costs of the Tenant Improvements, including architectural and engineering fees, permits, construction management, cabling, and Tenant's furniture up to $10.00 per rentable square foot.

2.2 Disbursement. Landlord shall disburse the Allowance directly to its contractor as the work progresses, and shall reimburse Tenant for any soft costs Tenant pays directly within thirty (30) days after Tenant submits invoices and lien waivers for the work covered.

2.3 Unused Allowance. Any portion of the Allowance not applied by the date twelve (12) months after the Commencement Date is forfeited, except that Tenant may apply up to $10.00 per rentable square foot of the unused Allowance as a credit against Base Rent.

2.4 Free Rent. In addition to the Allowance, Tenant shall receive four (4) months of free Base Rent, applied to months one through four of the Term. Tenant remains responsible for its share of Operating Expenses during the free rent period.

3. CHANGE ORDERS AND COST OVERRUNS

3.1 Change Orders. Tenant may request a change to the approved Construction Documents by written change order request. Landlord shall provide a written estimate of the cost and schedule impact within five (5) business days, and Tenant shall approve or withdraw the request within five (5) business days after receiving the estimate. Landlord shall not proceed with a change until Tenant approves the estimate in writing.

3.2 Cost Overruns. If the cost of the Tenant Improvements exceeds the Allowance, Tenant shall pay the excess cost. Tenant shall pay fifty percent (50%) of the projected excess before Landlord commences the affected work and the balance within thirty (30) days after substantial completion of the Tenant Improvements, in each case on invoice with supporting documentation.

3.3 Landlord Delay. If Landlord fails to meet a response deadline in Section 1.2 or 3.1, the Commencement Date is postponed by one day for each day of delay, and Base Rent abates accordingly.

3.4 Tenant Delay. A delay caused by Tenant's failure to meet a deadline in Section 1.2, by a change order Tenant requests, or by Tenant's selection of long-lead materials, does not postpone the Commencement Date, and Rent commences as if the Tenant Improvements had been substantially completed on the date they would have been but for the Tenant Delay.

4. SUBSTANTIAL COMPLETION AND PUNCH LIST

4.1 Substantial Completion. The Tenant Improvements are substantially complete when they are complete except for punch-list items that do not materially interfere with Tenant's use, and Landlord has obtained a certificate of occupancy or its local equivalent.

4.2 Punch List. Within ten (10) business days after substantial completion, Tenant and Landlord shall jointly inspect the Premises and prepare a punch list. Landlord shall complete the punch-list items within thirty (30) days, or, for items that reasonably require longer, shall begin within that period and prosecute completion diligently.

4.3 Warranty. Landlord warrants the Tenant Improvements against defects in materials and workmanship for one (1) year after substantial completion, and shall assign to Tenant, on request, the benefit of any longer manufacturer or contractor warranty.

5. GENERAL

5.1 Compliance. Landlord shall construct the Tenant Improvements in compliance with all applicable law, including the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable building codes, as they apply to the Premises as improved.

5.2 Access. Landlord shall permit Tenant and its vendors access to the Premises during the final thirty (30) days before substantial completion to install cabling, furniture, and equipment, at no charge and without triggering the commencement of Rent, provided the access does not interfere with Landlord's work.

5.3 Conflict. If this Work Letter conflicts with the Lease with respect to the Tenant Improvements, this Work Letter controls. Except as expressly set forth in this Work Letter, the Lease remains in full force and effect.

AGREED:
